_comment: The brand templates' variables. `type` decides escaping: attr and url are escaped, html is host markup printed as is, bool gates a {% if flag %} section and defaults to false. Each link defaults to arxiv.org, so a host passes only what differs.

static_base.doc: Root URL of the design-system asset route, with a trailing slash; production by default (init_app reads BRAND_STATIC_BASE).

base_url.doc: Scheme + BASE_SERVER, no trailing slash: home, search, submit and the IgnoreMe trap (init_app reads BASE_SERVER and EXTERNAL_URL_SCHEME).

auth_url.doc: Scheme + AUTH_SERVER (else BASE_SERVER), no trailing slash: /login and account_path; "" makes them site-relative.

account_path.doc: The signed-in Account page on auth_url, with its leading slash (the keycloak account portal: /user-account/).

help_url.doc: Scheme + HELP_SERVER, no trailing slash: donate and every footer info link.

hide_nav.doc: Drop the public nav and the search overlay, for a sub-site with its own (info.arxiv.org).

hide_announcement.doc: Drop the announcement band, for a host that shows none (a staff tool, an embedded view).

signed_in.doc: Per session: one "Account" link (auth_url + account_path, where the reader logs out) instead of "Log in".

member_institution.doc: Per request, the IP-matched member: '' (an anonymous reader), ', Name', or that span empty and hidden, which chrome/header.js fills from the same-origin /institutional_banner.
